verse.verse_3: What shall let you know what the Clatterer is!
verse.verse_4: On that Day people shall become like scattered moths
verse.verse_5: and the mountains like tufts of carded wool.
verse.verse_6: Then he whose deeds weigh heavy in the Scale
verse.verse_7: shall live in a life which is pleasing,
verse.verse_8: but he whose weight is light in the Scale,
verse.verse_9: his head will be in the Plunging
verse.verse_10: What shall let you know what the Plunging is?
verse.verse_11: (It is) a Fire which is extremely hot.
